title: Resettlement
summary: RESET'TLEMENT, noun 1. The act of settling or composing again. The resettlement of my discomposed soul. 2. The state of settling or subsiding again; as the resettlement of lees. 3. A second settlement

inlines.v: RESET'TLEMENT, noun 1. The act of settling or composing again. The resettlement of my discomposed soul. 2. The state of settling or subsiding again; as the resettlement of lees. 3. A second settlement in the ministry.
